# MPLADS Risk Monitor

> AI-driven monitoring, real-time risk assessment, and surveillance platform for Member of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS) developmental projects under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), Government of India.

The platform provides citizen transparency, geospatial risk mapping, fund allocation tracking, and automated anomaly detection across all 543 Lok Sabha parliamentary constituencies in India.

## Core Services

- [Geospatial Risk Map](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/#geospatial-map): Interactive national GIS map visualizing fund utilization, project progress, and AI anomaly scores across 543 constituencies.
- [National Statistics & Overview](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/#overview): Macro indicators tracking ₹12,500+ Cr invested across 18,450+ ongoing and completed infrastructure projects.
- [Key Features & Pillars](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/#features): Fund tracking, AI radar surveillance, cross-state performance benchmarks, and public accountability records.

## Documentation & Portals

- [Citizen Transparency Portal](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/): Public dashboard for tracking regional development works and fund utilization.
- [Member of Parliament (MP) Portal](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/login): Role-based portal for MPs to propose and track constituency project recommendations.
- [District Authority (DA) Portal](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/login): Administrative verification and sanction management interface for implementing agencies.
- [Full LLM Specification](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/llms-full.txt): Extended documentation and machine-readable data dictionary for autonomous agents.

## Optional

- [Agent Catalog](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): WebMCP and Agentic Resource Discovery manifest for autonomous agents.
- [Sitemap](https://mplads-risk-monitor.gov.in/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of accessible endpoints.
